pdf_sem_manifesto: Acquisition WITHOUT integrity manifest — nothing is asserted about preservation.
gc_titulo_janela: Case and Chain of Custody Manager
gc_tt_excluir_caso: Sends the whole case to the Windows Recycle Bin (restorable), after you confirm by typing its name. The deletion is kept in the access log.
gc_dispositivos_do_caso: Devices in the case — the document buttons below apply to the device selected in this list:
gc_tt_exportar: Copies the selected documents (Ctrl/Shift for several) to a USB drive or folder, verifies each copy by its hash, issues a receipt and records it in the case.
gc_tt_autorizacao: Attaches the court order, consent form or request to the case — including when the document was only scanned after the collection.
gc_tt_relatorio: Converts SMS, calls and contacts into one CSV per artifact (opens in Excel) and a consolidated PDF, outside the sealed acquisition.
gc_tt_relatorio_extracao: Issues the acquisition's technical report: environment, method, outcome per module, files by category, inventory and seal.
gc_tt_ficha: Quick-read cover: opens with what the collection obtained — lock state when received, device and line identification, security and outcome. Each field cites its sealed source; what did not come through is marked NOT DETERMINED.
gc_tt_laudo: Issues the device's forensic examination report: material examined, methodology, limitations, results, integrity and conclusion, with the examiner's statements.
gc_tt_conversas: Pick the relevant conversations (WhatsApp, SMS, MMS) and generate their PDF, in full. The complete set of all of them stays in the spreadsheet and the HTML notebook.
gc_tt_decifrar: Android: decrypts the WhatsApp backup (.crypt15) with the 64-digit key. iPhone: decrypts the encrypted backup with the backup password. The cleartext material stays outside the sealed acquisition.
gc_nenhum_caso: No case found in the extractions folder.
gc_sem_aquisicao: This case has no acquisition recorded yet.
gc_ficha_divergentes:
⚠ Case data divergent across acquisitions: {campos}.
The record shows the version from the most recent acquisition. Use 'Amend Case Data' to create the case's single record.
gc_ficha_caso_anterior: Case predating the single record: the data below was read from within the acquisitions.
gc_excluir_corpo:
The whole case {nome} — acquisitions, documents, reports and addenda — will be sent to the Windows Recycle Bin. You can restore it from there; deleting it for good means emptying the Recycle Bin.

To confirm, type the case name ({nome}):
gc_caso_excluido_corpo: Case {nome} was sent to the Windows Recycle Bin and the deletion was recorded.

{erro}
gc_selecione_aquisicao: Select an acquisition in the list.
gc_senha_iphone_gerada: Temporary password generated by the suite in this acquisition (stored in backup_ios_cifrado/senha_do_backup.txt and checked against the seal). Confirm to decrypt:
gc_senha_iphone_definida: Backup password set on the iPhone (not the unlock passcode). It will appear in the decryption record so it can be repeated:

gc_laudo_protocolos_falha: The report was generated, but the responses to the questions submitted could NOT be filed with the case ({erro}). They exist only inside the report.
gc_docs_contagem: {n} document(s) for this acquisition — double-click to open.
gc_docs_nenhum: No document generated yet for this acquisition. Use the buttons below.
gc_escolha_documento: Choose a document in the list.
gc_selecione_documentos: Select one or more documents in the list.
gc_salvar_copia_titulo: Save a copy of the document
gc_selecione_caso: Select a case in the list.
gc_caso_retificado_corpo:
The case record was updated and the change was recorded as an addendum, with the previous values.

The already-sealed acquisitions were not touched.
gc_selecione_dispositivo_retificar: Select a device in the list to amend.
gc_selada_corpo:
This collection already has an integrity manifest.

Rewriting it would make the case diverge from its own seal and would erase the record of what existed at the time of examination.

The change can be filed as an ADDENDUM to the case: the collected material stays untouched, and the amendment is recorded with its own date.

File it as an addendum?
gc_autorizacao_anexada_corpo:
Attached to the case:
  {lista}

The case was re-sealed and the filing was recorded as an addendum, with each document's hash.

The earlier acquisitions were NOT altered and do not come to include this document: each one records what was visible at the time it was made.
gc_selecione_dispositivo: Select a device in the list.
gc_selecione_aquisicao_especifica: Select a specific acquisition to generate the report.
gc_fuso_corpo:
The device's dates are in numeric form and need to be converted. The chosen time zone will be stated in the report.

The device's own clock, measured at collection, is in the acquisition's registro_procedimento.txt — check it if in doubt.
gc_sem_planilha: NO CSV SPREADSHEET WAS GENERATED, because there was no record to present. The reasons are above and in PROCEDENCIA.txt.
gc_descartes: ATTENTION: {n} fragment(s) of the raw material could NOT be interpreted and are not in the report. It is incomplete relative to the evidence — see NAO_INTERPRETADO.txt.
gc_origens_divergentes: ATTENTION: the source material no longer matches the collection seal: {origens}
gc_relatorio_nao_altera: The acquisition was not altered: the report is a derived document and stays outside what was sealed.
